raw_response:
I have farmed this small plot in Mtwara for many years, and with only 0.32 hectares there is no money to waste on shop-bought fertilizer or new seed when my own seed from last season is still good. The rains here come when God sends them, so we do not water the crops, and on a piece of land this size my family and I can manage the digging, planting, and weeding ourselves without paying workers. We never spray chemicals because maize does not need them here, and manure is too scarce to spread on this sandy soil.
